comment: Narrowed. At separation 5 the pairwise sum holds at noise level in every in-domain run I have: 008 (B-C, N=2, error 0.0050), 009 (A-C, N=2, 0.0051), r2/001 (A,B,C triangle, side 5, N=3, 0.0050), r3/002 (A,A,A triangle, side 5, N=3, 0.0051). The same domain (species ABC, separations 3 to 5) contains 2026-11-19/r1/lab-vernier/007, two A particles at separation 3.0. The paper's predictor fails there: error about 900 (its unsoftened 1/r^2.5 diverges when the pair closes to 0.17, and the measured pair does pass through at t = 1.24). This is the same failure as P-0003 at r = 3. A-A at separation 3 is not supported, so I propose r 5 only, with N <= 3, until other separations are tested. I have not tested mixed pairs at separations 3 or 4 here; 2026-11-20/r1/lab-vernier/005 (A-B at 4) and 006 (B-C at 3) are filed. I will update this review when they return. The four-particle run (c1) is not mine and is not cited.
